## Dole plc Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Release


Oct 19 2026


Download (opens in new window)


DUBLIN--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Dole plc (NYSE: DOLE) (the “Company”) will announce its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on Monday, November 9, 2026, prior to the market opening. The Company’s management will host a webcast on the same day at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time.


A presentation to accompany the discussion, along with a press release and other supplemental financial information, will be available at[www.doleplc.com/investor-relations/financials](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.doleplc.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Ffinancials&esheet=54623308&newsitemid=20261019416840&lan=en-US&anchor=www.doleplc.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Ffinancials&index=1&md5=66fd9361871be255d38cfb7b2fdfd739) .


The live webcast and a replay after the event can be accessed at[www.doleplc.com/investor-relations/events-and-presentations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.doleplc.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Fevents-and-presentations&esheet=54623308&newsitemid=20261019416840&lan=en-US&anchor=www.doleplc.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Fevents-and-presentations&index=2&md5=d1c5b3f1dfe74e646fb7512f662d568a) or directly at[www.events.q4inc.com/attendee/145693531](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F145693531&esheet=54623308&newsitemid=20261019416840&lan=en-US&anchor=www.events.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F145693531&index=3&md5=7af40f2c184bf9d0858f50feaf8f143a) .


**About Dole plc:**


A global leader in fresh produce,[Dole plc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.doleplc.com%2F&esheet=54623308&newsitemid=20261019416840&lan=en-US&anchor=Dole+plc&index=4&md5=deb3234562b270c4bb67e758c761d69d) grows, markets, and distributes an extensive variety of fresh fruits and vegetables sourced locally and from around the world. Dedicated and passionate in exceeding our customers’ requirements in over 85 countries, our goal is to make the world a healthier and more sustainable place.


Category: Financial
